sources.note: Main product site. Single-page marketing site describing CloudCraft as cloud-hosted EHR with EHR, practice management, billing, and HR modules. Minimal feature detail. Contact emails point to naiacorp.com/naiacorp.net.

ONC mandatory disclosure page. Same marketing content as homepage — describes all-in-one EHR/PM/billing/HR solution. Links to certification criteria, CQM, SED, G1/G2, compliance activities, and real world testing pages.

B10 EHI export documentation. Describes provider export via bulk download console, supported formats (C-CDA USCDI v3, PDF, images, Word, tasks/notes), and patient export via FHIR R4 DocumentReference.

Birmingham wiki article on NAIA Corporation. Founded 1997 by Terry Lee. IT services firm. Offices in Birmingham AL, Hyderabad India, Birmingham England. Tanveer Patel hired as CEO in 2010. Moved to 32nd Street office in 2009.
ZoomInfo listing for NAIA Corp. 11-50 employees. Page was 403 forbidden but search snippet confirmed company size and Birmingham AL location.
Goshen Medical Center staff portal hosted on NAIA infrastructure. Login page with email/password and Office 365 auth. Confirms Goshen Medical Center (NC FQHC) as CloudCraft customer.
Goshen Medical career center hosted on CloudCraft/NAIA platform. Shows job postings for physicians, NPs, PAs, nurses, MAs, front desk, dental, pharmacy, finance staff across 38 locations.

Goshen Medical Center official site. Confirmed as FQHC serving eastern North Carolina with 38 service locations. Services include family practice, internal medicine, pediatrics, dental, pharmacy, telehealth, mobile medical units.
CloudCraft EHR QA web application login page. Version 8.1.2 visible. Shows email/password login with Office 365 option. Explicitly drops IE support. Post-login redirects to 'Choose Team' page.
CloudCraft patient portal. Angular SPA loading from cloudcraft-ehr.naiacorp.net. Uses AWS infrastructure for version management. Minimal content visible without JavaScript execution.
CloudCraft clinical/EMR module. Branded 'EMR - CloudCraft'. Angular SPA hosted on cloudcraft-ehr.naiacorp.net with AWS versioning. No features visible without authentication.
CloudCraft sliding fee scale module. Indicates FQHC-specific functionality for income-based discount programs. Angular SPA, no features visible without auth.
FHIR API documentation/test page. Lists CloudCraft and Goshen Medical Center as practice endpoints. References FHIR R4 resources. Links to API documentation for consuming health resources.
Business Alabama article on Tanveer Patel. Page returned 403 but search snippet referenced NAIA/ConcertCare and healthcare IT involvement in Alabama.
Business Alabama article titled 'Medical IT Multiplier'. Page returned 403 — likely about NAIA's healthcare IT work but content inaccessible.
